%% =====================================================================
%%  Master's thesis template (English)
%%  Hosei University, Graduate School of Science and Engineering
%%  Intelligent Systems Laboratory
%% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
%%  - Compile with LuaLaTeX (on Overleaf: Menu -> Settings -> Compiler).
%%  - Edit: the "Thesis information" below, the chapters in chapters/,
%%          references.bib (bibliography) and figures/ (figures).
%%  - Do not edit hosei-thesis.cls or latexmkrc.
%%  - See README.md for details.
%% =====================================================================

%  Class options
%    ja / en            language of the thesis (Japanese / English)
%    bachelor / master  bachelor's thesis / master's thesis
%    review             add this when you send a draft to your supervisor
%                       (shows line numbers, \TODO and \rev; remove it for submission)
\documentclass[en,master]{hosei-thesis}

%% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
%%  Thesis information (printed on the cover page)
%%  The cover follows the format required by the Graduate School,
%%  so its labels are in Japanese.
%% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
%  Use \\ to choose where a long title breaks on the cover
%  (Japanese text can otherwise break in the middle of a word).
\titleEN{Solving the YY Problem Using XX}            % title (English)
\titleJA{○○を用いた△△問題の解法}                     % title (Japanese)
\author{法政 太郎}             % name (as registered at the university)
\authorkana{ホウセイ タロウ}    % name in katakana (フリガナ, required)
\studentid{25R0000}           % student ID (学生証番号)
\supervisor{劉 子昂}           % supervisor (指導教員)
\fiscalyear{2026}             % set to your submission academic year and keep it fixed (April-March)

%% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
%%  Extra packages and your own commands (only if needed).
%%  Packages for figures, tables, math, algorithms and code are already loaded.
%% ---------------------------------------------------------------------
% \usepackage{...}
% \newcommand{\vect}[1]{\boldsymbol{#1}}

\begin{document}

\maketitle                         % cover page

\frontmatter                       % front matter (pages i, ii, ...)
\input{chapters/abstract}          % Abstract (English) and 要旨 (Japanese)
\tableofcontents
\listoffigures
\listoftables

\mainmatter                        % main text (pages 1, 2, ...)
\input{chapters/01-introduction}    % Introduction
\input{chapters/02-preliminaries}   % Preliminaries (existing knowledge)
\input{chapters/03-related-work}    % Related Work
\input{chapters/04-method}          % Proposed Method (your contribution)
\input{chapters/05-experiments}     % Computational Experiments
\input{chapters/06-conclusion}      % Conclusion

\input{chapters/acknowledgments}
\bibliography{references}          % generated from references.bib
\input{chapters/publications}      % list of publications (delete this line if you have none)

\appendix                          % appendices (Appendix A, B, ...)
\input{chapters/appendix}

\end{document}
